## Research Interests

Complex systems, network science, agent-based modeling, computational economics, and computational approaches to public policy. See the [Research](research.qmd) page for a full description.

## Selected Projects

## Quantitative / Computational Methods

Pattern recognition and computational intelligence (prototype-based classifiers, neural networks, differential evolution and other optimization methods); data engineering and ETL; Python, Java, SQL; workflow orchestration (Airflow); containerized deployment (Kubernetes); business intelligence and data visualization (Power BI); relational databases, data architecture, quality, and governance; time-series analysis; network analysis; and, as part of my current research transition, agent-based modeling.

:::
